result.document_summary: A mid-document fragment of a gocodebook.com page, labeled as San Diego Municipal Code §98.1103 on algorithmic devices, but the text consists solely of Chapter 2 (Government) material: Council rules on agendas, closed sessions and amendments, and City Manager administrative provisions.
result.notes: The text in this part is entirely unrelated to the six in-scope categories. It covers Council meeting agendas, closed-session noticing and reporting, temporary rules, publication of ordinances, and City Manager administration (Municipal Code Chapter 2). The URL and metadata suggest the page concerns the prohibition of algorithmic rent-setting devices (§98.1103), but no provision on algorithmic rent setting or any other in-scope rule appears in this part, so no rules were extracted. Later parts of the document may contain the actual section text.
